name: Verd Viaduct
zag_role: First Slovenian application of an expansive grout additive
description: The first structure on which the Ikaton expansive additive was used for grouting prestressing cable ducts. The additive compensates for the shrinkage of cement grout so that the duct fills completely and the tendon is protected from corrosion. Built by Beograjska Mostogradnja. The additive line was developed at ZAG.
history: The viaduct carries the A1 motorway across the plain at the headwaters of the Ljubljanica near Vrhnika and was built by Beograjska Mostogradnja. It was the first structure on which the Ikaton expansive additive was used for grouting prestressing cable ducts. The additive compensates for the shrinkage of cement grout so that the duct fills completely and the tendon is protected from corrosion, which is one of the principal durability problems in post tensioned concrete bridges.
facts: Ikaton expansive grout additive, first use in Slovenia
complete filling of prestressing cable ducts
